title: Unarmed Event Security - Detroit
description:
Unarmed Event Security

Battle Tested Security is the most Qualified, Professional and Honest security services provider in the live events industry, changing the relationship between fans and security, one event at a time.

The Job:

We are looking for veterans and security minded professionals to join our mission. As an Unarmed Event Security Officer on our team, you will serve a pivotal role in keeping event patrons safe, and cultivating a fun and secure atmosphere in our venues. Responsibilities vary depending on the event/venue, but may include:

  • Securing stage barricades to provide a safe working area for artists and event staff.
  • Securing entry points, conducting bag checks, and performing entry screenings to ensure no unauthorized items or persons enter the venue.
  • Patrolling assigned areas to ensure attendee safety and prevent theft/damage to infrastructure.
  • Providing exceptional customer service by interacting with patrons and answering questions.
  • Ensuring the safety of patrons by monitoring for dehydration, and by identifying and addressing possible altercations before they occur.
  • Handling patron interactions with empathy, enforcing policies with a professional and calm attitude.
  • Collaborating with law enforcement and medical services to resolve any critical safety issues.
  • You must meet the requirements and be able to obtain a Michigan Guard Card.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive pay: $15 - $18 per hour starting pay, depending on experience and certifications
  • Cultivate your leadership skills and follow our Internal Career Growth Track.
  • Experience military camaraderie without the B.S., in a structured environment built for your success.
  • Work in a fun and engaging atmosphere, attending concerts and massive festivals that some pay thousands to witness. Opportunities to travel out of market for major events.
  • Flexible schedule - work a few events, or work all of them.

About You:

You love concerts and live events, and want to be part of creating a fun and safe environment for fans. You understand that events can require long hours on your feet (12-18 hour shifts), and sometimes take place during adverse weather conditions. You have good judgment, strong observational skills, and can operate independently with minimal supervision.

You embody our core values:

  • Bearing - Have a high level of professionalism in terms of gesture and appearance
  • Accountability - Hold ourselves and those around us accountable to the highest standards possible
  • Transparency - Be open and honest to ourselves and others when dealing with any situation
  • Tact - Be sensitive, considerate, understanding, and thoughtful when interacting with others
  • Loyalty - Be devoted and faithful to the mission of supporting the veteran community
  • Enthusiasm - Be interested, excited, and engaged with the mission and community we serve

About Us:

We are a certified 8(a) Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business with a 60% Veteran labor force. Our mission is to enhance the lives of the military community and ensure a successful transition from active service. Our vision is to be the industry leader in the quality of our teams and the services we provide. Whether you are a transitioning service member looking to exit the military and into a great company, or a long-time veteran who is looking for a career change, we’d be happy to speak with you. Not military? No problem. We are an equal opportunity employer, and are excited to meet candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences

title: General Maintenance ("Mantenimiento General")
description:
POSITION PURPOSE

To repair and maintain the physical structure of the resort and provide technical and administrative support to the Maintenance Dept.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBLITIES

  • Perform minor and routine painting, plumbing, electrical wiring, and other related maintenance activities, using hand tools.
  • Perform preventative maintenance for guest rooms, including vinyl repair touch up paint minor furniture repair tub caulking tile repairs etc.
  • Perform preventative maintenance for ice machines refrigerators kitchen equipment laundry equipment HVAC guestrooms meeting rooms the swimming pool and hot tub.
  • Perform plumbing repair, laundry equipment repairs, preventative maintenance on all exhaust fans and supply, monitor energy conservation.
  • Replace air conditioner filters.
  • Repair vacuum cleaners and any other small equipment upon request.
  • Immediately follow up on any alarms to determine the exact location and cause - determine emergency status and report to the Front Desk with findings.
  • Understand and respond to all guest needs and requests in a timely and professional manner.
  • Immediately report all suspicious occurrences and hazardous conditions.
  • Always maintain the cleanliness of work areas.
  • Practice safe work habits at all times, to avoid injury to self and others.
  • To perform other tasks, including cross-training, as directed.
  • Display strong general mechanical ability
  • Display solid knowledge and skill in the safe use of hand and power tools and other materials required to perform repair and maintenance tasks.
  • Use the lockout/tagout system before performing and maintenance work.
  • Notify management concerning the need for major repairs or additions to lighting, heating, and ventilating equipment.
  • All other duties as assigned by manager or supervisor.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Noise and vibration are sufficient noise, either constant or intermittent, to cause marked distraction or possible injury to the sense of hearing, and / or sufficient vibration (production of an oscillating movement or strain on the body or its extremities from repeated motion or shock) to cause bodily harm if endured day after day.
  • Environmental conditions are both, inside and outside, a job is considered both if the activities occur inside or outside in approximately equal amounts. Temperature is moderate and controlled by hotel environmental systems.
  • Must be able to stand and exert well-paced mobility for up to four (4) hours in length.
  • Must be able to exert well-paced ability to reach other departments of the hotel on a timely basis.
  • Must be able to exert well-paced ability to maneuver between functions occurring simultaneously.
  • Must be able to lift up to 75 lbs. occasionally.
  • Must be able to push and pull carts and equipment weighing up to 250 lbs. occasionally.
  • Requires grasping, writing, standing, sitting, walking, repetitive motions, bending, climbing, listening, and hearing ability and visual acuity.
  • Talking and hearing occur continuously in the process of communicating with guests, supervisors, and subordinates.
  • Vision occurs continuously with the most common visual functions being those of near and color vision and depth perception.
  • Must be able to bend, stoop, squat and stretch to fulfill tasks occasionally.
  • Requires manual dexterity to use and operate all necessary equipment.
  • Ability to work primarily with fingers to pick, pinch, type and carry out substantial movements (motions) of the wrists and hands as well.

SUPPORTIVE FUNCTIONS

In addition to performance of the essential functions, this position may be required to perform a combination of the following supportive functions, with the percentage of time performing each function to be solely determined by the manager based upon the particular requirements of the hotel:

  • Assist with any guest inquiry.
  • Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures.
  • Report maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries.
  • Complete safety training and certifications.
  • Any other duties as requested by direct and indirect supervisors.

SPECIFIC JOB KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

The individual must possess the following knowledge, skills and abilities and be able to explain and demonstrate that he or she can perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation, using some other combination of knowledge, skills, and abilities:

  • Must be able to speak, read, write, and understand the primary language used in the workplace.
  • Requires good communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Must have excellent customer relations skills.
  • Must be detail oriented with outstanding organizational and communication skills.
  • Must possess basic computer skills.
  • Must possess basic computational ability.
  • Ability to effectively deal with internal and external customers some of whom will require high levels of patience, tact and diplomacy and collect accurate information to resolve conflicts.
  • Self-driven and able to work independently.
  • Exceptionally strong in issue resolution and proven analytical skills with a strong attention to detail.
  • Work with a variety of situations.
  • React quickly in emergency situations and make decisions that may involve large expenditures or the safety of others.
  • Must be able to read and interpret drawings, diagrams, and design plans of all trades.

EDUCATION

  • High school or equivalent education required.
  • English fluency required.

EXPERIENCE

  • Must have three to five years of experience in general building trades, with technical building maintenance (commercial) background preferred.

LICENSES OR CERTIFICATIONS

  • Ability to provide and maintain a valid drivers license as the position may require the operation of motorized and electric vehicles.
  • Licensed in a trade preferred (plumbing, electrical, HVAC, carpentry, etc.)

GROOMING

All Staff Members must maintain a neat, clean, and well-groomed appearance per Azul Hospitality standards. Refer to the property specific required grooming and uniform standards policy.

ATTENDANCE

Regular attendance in conformance with the standards, which may be established by Azul Hospitality, from time to time, is essential to the successful performance of this position. Staff with irregular attendance / tardiness will be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment. Upon employment, all staff is required to fully comply with Azul Hospitality rules and regulations for the safe and effective operation of the hotels facilities. Staff members who violate hotel rules and regulations will be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment. Due to the cyclical nature of the hospitality industry, staff members may be required to work varying schedules to reflect the business needs of the hotel. In addition, attendance at all scheduled training sessions and meetings is required. This job description is not an exclusive or exhaustive list of all job functions that a staff member in this position may be asked to perform from time to time.

Extraordinary companies are founded by extraordinary people. Fritz Winter undoubtedly belongs in this circle of people. His ability to inspire people with his ideas was crucial to the success of Fritz Winter Eisengieerei. Winter founded his first foundry in 1932 at the age of just 22 and built it up into one of the most important in central Germany before losing it through expropriation at the end of the war. A wealth of ideas, expertise, drive and an indomitable will to assert himself combined with human greatness and a sense of social responsibility - he anchored these values in the Fritz Winter iron foundry, so that they are still effective today.

title: Batch Maker
location: Tnemec North Kansas City - NORTH KANSAS CITY, MO 64116
description:
Position Summary

The Production Engineer – High-Speed Batchmaking is a technically skilled, hands-on manufacturing position responsible for the safe, efficient, and accurate production of coatings and related chemical products within a high-speed manufacturing environment.

This position represents an evolution of the traditional batchmaker role, combining chemical and engineering knowledge, advanced manufacturing technology, process control, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement with hands-on production responsibilities.

The Production Engineer will operate and optimize high-speed batching equipment, automated process controls, material handling systems, and associated manufacturing technology while ensuring products are manufactured in accordance with established formulations, quality standards, production schedules, and safety requirements.

The successful candidate will possess a strong technical foundation in engineering, chemistry, chemical processing, or a related scientific discipline and will be comfortable applying that knowledge directly on the manufacturing floor.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

High-Speed Batch Manufacturing

  • Manufacture coatings and related chemical products according to established formulas, batch tickets, standard operating procedures, and production schedules.
  • Operate high-speed batching, mixing, dispersion, pumping, transfer, and material-handling equipment.
  • Accurately charge raw materials according to established formulas and sequencing requirements.
  • Monitor temperature, agitation, mixing speed, viscosity, weight, pressure, time, and other critical process parameters.
  • Utilize automated manufacturing systems and process controls to monitor and manage batch production.
  • Complete production documentation and electronic batch records accurately and in real time.
  • Coordinate with Filling, Material Handling, Quality Control, Scheduling, and other manufacturing functions to maintain efficient product flow.

Process Engineering & Technical Support

  • Apply engineering and/or chemistry principles to understand and control manufacturing processes.
  • Evaluate process conditions and identify opportunities to improve batch cycle time, throughput, consistency, quality, and equipment utilization.
  • Troubleshoot manufacturing issues involving equipment, raw materials, process conditions, formulas, or operating procedures.
  • Identify abnormal process conditions and take appropriate corrective action within established operating parameters.
  • Partner with Manufacturing, Quality Control, R&D, Engineering, Maintenance, and Continuous Improvement personnel to resolve production issues.
  • Assist with manufacturing trials, new product introductions, process changes, scale-up activities, and equipment commissioning.
  • Provide technical feedback regarding manufacturability and opportunities for process improvement.

Quality & Process Control

  • Ensure batches are manufactured according to established specifications and quality requirements.
  • Understand the relationship between raw materials, processing conditions, and finished-product performance.
  • Perform or support in-process testing and sampling as required.
  • Work closely with Quality Control when adjustments or additional testing are required.
  • Identify process deviations and participate in root-cause investigations and corrective actions.
  • Maintain accurate raw-material, batch, lot, and process documentation to support product traceability.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to reduce batch cycle time, material loss, rework, downtime, and process variation.
  • Participate in Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Analyze production performance and recommend improvements to equipment, processes, work instructions, and manufacturing methods.
  • Support efforts to improve gallons produced per labor hour and overall manufacturing capacity.
  • Assist in establishing standardized work and best practices for high-speed batchmaking operations.
  • Help transition manufacturing processes from operator-dependent practices toward standardized, repeatable, data-driven processes.

Equipment & Technology

  • Operate computerized and automated manufacturing systems used to control production equipment.
  • Understand equipment operating parameters and recognize abnormal operating conditions.
  • Perform routine equipment inspections and basic troubleshooting.
  • Coordinate with Maintenance when mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, or automation support is required.
  • Participate in equipment upgrades, automation improvements, and implementation of new manufacturing technologies.
  • Maintain a clean and organized production environment utilizing established 5S principles.

Safety & Environmental Responsibility

  • Perform all work in accordance with company safety policies, OSHA requirements, environmental regulations, and established manufacturing procedures.
  • Properly handle chemicals, raw materials, and hazardous materials using required personal protective equipment.
  • Understand and follow Safety Data Sheets, chemical labeling requirements, and established chemical-handling procedures.
  • Identify unsafe conditions and immediately communicate safety concerns.
  • Participate in safety meetings, incident investigations, job hazard analyses, and continuous safety improvement activities.
  • Demonstrate personal ownership for maintaining a safe manufacturing environment.

location: Construction Innovations Corporate - Mather - Mather, CA 95655
description:
ABOUT CONSTRUCTION INNOVATIONS:

At Construction Innovations, we’re all about good energy — we create solutions that make electrical installations faster, safer, and cost-effective. Our products energize hundreds of projects across the U.S. in a variety of markets including solar, battery storage, substation, and transmission and distribution. Our commitment to simplifying traditional installation methods drives us to deliver all-in-one product kits that can be installed by anyone, in a fraction of the time. Our philosophy is at the core of everything we do: Innovate to Simplify®.

OVERVIEW:

The Materials Engineer develops, implements, and improves efficient, cost-effective, and repeatable manufacturing processes that meet product specifications, quality standards, and UL or other certification requirements. This role owns process design, tooling, production readiness, and manufacturing optimization to ensure safe, reliable, and compliant output. The position supports the Quality Management System (QMS), regulated manufacturing requirements, and shop floor implementation for new and revised products. It also ensures material selection and joining methods (including dissimilar metal bonding) are manufacturable, repeatable, and reliable over the product lifecycle.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Support development, implementation, and validation of metal joining processes for repeatability and manufacturability
  • Assist in evaluating risks related to galvanic corrosion, thermal expansion mismatch, and electrical resistance/joint performance
  • Observe production operations to identify and improve manufacturing process inefficiencies, quality issues, and safety risks
  • Troubleshoot production issues, support root cause analysis and corrective actions
  • Support data collection for product development, Lean, and continuous improvement
  • Assist with new product sample creation and testing
  • Support NPI launches, pilot builds, and training
  • Provide material selection feedback and basic manufacturability input to the design
  • Act as liaison between design and manufacturing for NPI
  • Support supervisors and quality teams with documentation, training, and updates
  • Follow QMS and UL change control procedures, support audits and inspections

DESIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

  • BS in Engineering (Materials, Manufacturing, Electrical, Industrial) or equivalent experience (5+ years)
  • Foundational knowledge of material compatibility and basic joining methods, including dissimilar metal interfaces
  • 2+ years of manufacturing/production engineering experience
  • Basic understanding of electrical assemblies and manufacturing processes
  • Exposure to Lean Manufacturing concepts
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work in regulated environments

Materials Engineer Level II

Includes all Responsibilities and Desired Skills & Experience indicated above, and the following additional responsibilities:

  • Own manufacturing processes for assigned products/subassemblies
  • Evaluate, design, and implement manufacturing methods, workflows, layouts, tooling, and assembly techniques to improve production flow and efficiency
  • Improve cost, quality, and efficiency using Lean principles
  • Provide structured DFM and material optimization feedback
  • Design, develop, test, or source product and manufacturing tools, fixtures, and equipment
  • Ensure compliance with UL and industry standards
  • Participate in UL audits, factory inspections, and compliance activities
  • Experience with dissimilar metal joining
  • 5+ years of manufacturing engineering experience
  • Experience with electrical assemblies and contract manufacturing


LOCATION:
Construction Innovations facilities and offices are located in Sacramento, CA and Mather, CA.


COMPENSATION:
A reasonable estimate of the current salary range for this position is $97,300 - $156,400 annually. The actual amount offered within this range will depend on a variety of factors, including geography, skills and abilities, education, experience, and other relevant job-related factors. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for the role, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

Who is New-Indy?

A joint venture between The Kraft Group and Schwarz Partners LP was formed to establish New-Indy. The company name is derived from being the Newest Independent manufacturer and supplier of recycled containerboard in the corrugated box industry.

With over 2,000 employees from Southern California to the coasts of the Carolinas, New-Indy plays an integral role in the everyday lives of people across the country and around the world through its innovative packaging solutions to serve the needs of every customer.

Our Mission

Our mission is to be an integral contributor to the Kraft Group and Schwarz Partners; consistently delivering returns above the cost of capital and exceeding the expectations of customers and business owners, while maintaining the safest working environment.

The Kraft Group

Headquartered in Foxborough, Massachusetts, the Kraft Group is the holding company for the Kraft family’s various businesses, with concentrated interests in five areas: paper and packaging manufacturing and the distribution of forest products; sports and entertainment; real estate and development; private equity investing and philanthropy.

The paper and packaging division is comprised of the Rand-Whitney Group, International Forest Products and New-Indy Containerboard. Conducting business in more than 100 countries, the Kraft Group forms one of the largest privately-owned paper, packaging and distribution companies in the world, trading more than 4 million tons of pulp and paper grades annually.

The Royal Group, the packaging division of Schwarz Partners, services customers in the automotive, agriculture, industrial manufacturing and consumer goods industries throughout North America and consists of 33 locations, 12 of which are corrugated box and sheet plants. POSITION PURPOSE: The CNA is responsible for providing residents with the highest quality of direct routine care in all activities of daily living, under the supervision of the LPN or RN and in accordance with the Nursing Assistant Program standards, the Resident’s Bill of Rights and the Facility Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement (QAPI) program. According to the Plan of Care for the resident, CNAs apply skills in basic nursing, personal care and basic restorative services while understanding the mental health and social service needs of the resident and being mindful of the needs in cognitively impaired residents. The CNA is part of the interdisciplinary care team that is dedicated to promoting independence, autonomous decision-making and facilitating residents to achieve and maintain the highest practicable physical mental and psychosocial well-being.

The CMA is accountable for all provisions within and performing the primary duties of the signed, attached CNA job description. The CMA will also administer medications and treatments under the direct supervision of a nurse.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF POSITION:

QUALITY OF CARE

  • Provides ongoing resident care upholding and promoting the resident’s right to be free from abuse, mistreatment, neglect, or misappropriation of resident property, immediately reporting any suspicions, reports or witnessed events to appropriate facility staff.
  • Forms quality relationships, communicating and interacting competently on a one-to-one basis while integrating the resident-centered Plan of Care
  • Demonstrates sensitivity to physical, mental, and psychosocial needs as well as maintaining dignity, while skillfully performing directed nursing, personal cares and restorative services
  • Supports and promotes residents’ rights and attainment of as much functional independence as possible.
  • Maximizes quality of living through continual monitoring and reporting of resident care, ensuring all outcomes are thoroughly and accurately documented.
  • Provides the highest quality care to all residents, without regard to race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, age or differences in culture.
  • Maintains awareness of facility QAPI goals and abides by and promotes the QAPI program.
  • Practices and promotes a strong culture of customer service, ensuring a resident-centered experience.

BASIC NURSING, PERSONAL CARES AND BASIC RESTORATIVE SERVICES

  • Facilitates Plan of Care through completion of nursing responsibilities, clearly communicating resident needs to primary caregivers and reporting changes and responses to interventions to the LPN or RN
  • Completes basic nursing cares as directed such as taking and recording vital signs; measuring and recording height and weight; recognizing abnormal changes in body functioning and reporting to the LPN or RN; and caring for resident who are actively dying.
  • Completes personal care as directed such as bathing; grooming; mouth care; dressing; toileting; eating and hydration; proper feeding techniques; skin care; and transfers, positioning and turning.
  • Facilitates adequate nutritional intake for resident through assisting to and from the dining area; feeding or assisting to feed; monitoring and recording intake and output; passing water and offering fluids; passing and collecting trays; serving supplemental nourishment as directed by nurse; maintaining awareness of dietary restrictions; and following safety guidelines including wearing gloves when handling food or hydration.
  • Completes basic restorative services as directed such as training residents in self-care and according to the resident’s abilities; use of assistive devices in transferring, ambulation, eating, and dressing; maintenance of range of motion; proper turning and positioning in bed and chair bowel and bladder training; and care and use of prosthetic and orthotic devices.
  • Assists nurses with special procedures as directed, including implementing and completing critical care sheets, participating in care conferences, etc.
  • Provides and ensures nursing care activities are practiced in accordance with Nursing Assistant Program standards while protecting residents’ dignity, privacy, and autonomous decision-making whenever possible.
  • Facilitates assistance in areas such as getting to and participating in activities as well as assistance in resolving any grievances or disputes.
  • Articulates meaningful discussion with residents based on their unique backgrounds, likes and dislikes.
  • Maintains care and security of residents’ personal possessions.
  • Interact with resident’s family or support network, visitors and members of the interdisciplinary care team in a courteous and cooperative manner.
  • Recognizes limits of knowledge, skill and experience; facilitates situations beyond the CNAs competency.

COMPLIANCE – SAFETY, DOCUMENTATION, HIPAA

  • Ensure all call lights are promptly and courteously answered.
  • Uses proper body mechanics, at all times, and reminds other nursing staff or facilitates correction.
  • Constantly adheres to safety policies and procedures in lifting, positioning and equipment use, including use of transfer belts, Hoyer or mechanical lifts.
  • Strictly follows Standard Precaution infection control procedures and OSHA guidelines regarding bloodborne pathogens to provide safe nursing care to include proper handwashing; maintaining disinfection/cleaning schedules; wearing PPE such as gloves, face shield, fluid resistant gowns, etc.
  • Maintains a safe, clean environment in resident rooms and facility following infection control procedures to bag infectious linens and equipment or proper disposal of them; proper handwashing, disinfection/cleaning schedules.
  • Avoids the need for restraints in accordance with DHS nursing home standards.
  • Ensures all cares are documented and that resident records are complete through systematic collection, reporting and documentation of data that is secure from unauthorized access and follows state and federal regulations, including HIPAA to ensure privacy and maintain confidentiality.
  • Promptly reports and documents incidents and errors involving residents, staff, visitors or self.
  • Prioritizes work assignments consistent with number and level of staff available and resident care acuity.
  • Reviews, departing staff report at start of shift, ensure duties and delegated tasks are complete at end of shift and reports off to nurse when leaving.

ADDITIONAL ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

MEDICATION ADMINISTRATION

  • Accurately administers regularly scheduled medications to residents via oral, eye, ear, rectal, inhalant and topical routes under the direction and supervision of an LPN or RN
  • Assists resident with self-administration, if applicable
  • Documents after administration the date, time, dosage and method of administration of all medications or reason for not administering the medication as ordered, including the signature of the nurse or physician who is authorized to administer or observe.
  • Complies with pharmaceutical policies including sign out and administration of medications; reporting and documenting medication errors; obtaining and transcribing physician orders; proper procedure for label changes and expirations; following controlled substance policies and end of shift count; documenting PRNs as allowed.
  • Understands the metric, apothecary and medical abbreviations and their meanings.
  • Knows and follows proper procedure to access the ER Kit and contacts licensed nurse to follow through.
  • Recognizes limits of knowledge, skill, experience; facilitates situations beyond the CMA’s competency.

title: 2nd shift- Processing Technician
description:
Join the TEAM at Western Smokehouse Partners!

Starting Pay: $20.50 an hour

Work Schedule: Monday - Friday 2:30pm - 11pm

We’re more than just a leader in the better-for-you meat snack industry-we’re a team driven by quality, innovation and a passion for great meat sticks and jerky. With eight facilities across five states, we’re setting the standard in excellence for our co-manufacturing and private label customers. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for highly motivated individuals who want to be part of an industry-leading company that values contribution, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Western Smokehouse Partners is looking for a fulltime Processing Team Member.

The Processing Team Member is responsible for producing raw meat products by performing a variety of tasks including receiving, grinding, mixing, stuffing, linking, cooking, and documentation to ensure adherence to customer specifications, Quality Assurance (QA) standards, and USDA regulations. This position plays a critical role in maintaining product quality, food safety, and production efficiency. The technician must be detail-oriented, safety-focused, and capable of working in a cold environment with frequent lifting and repetitive motion.

Essential Duties

  • Conduct pre-operational inspections of machines, processing rooms, and equipment.

  • Receive incoming shipments and complete required documentation and inspections.

  • Maintain and rotate inventory using FIFO (First In, First Out) practices.

  • Accurately scan ingredients into Vista Trac to ensure traceability and inventory accuracy.

  • Store meat in appropriate freezers or coolers for production staging.

  • Weigh and grind raw materials to precise batch specifications.

  • Mix ingredients according to batch formulas and product requirements.

  • Set up, operate, and adjust equipment to meet specific product and customer requirements.

  • Stuff meat into casings using appropriate v-mags and ensure correct casing cuts.

  • Hang and inspect meat sticks on the linking line for quality control.

  • Load smokehouses and start programs per batch specifications.

  • Clean and sanitize equipment and work areas before and after production.

  • Maintain cleanliness of the production floor by removing debris and following disposal protocols.

  • Label and tag product racks with accurate product names, flavors, and color codes.

  • Verify accuracy of product labels and tags for compliance with specifications.

  • Wear all required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) while on the production floor.

  • Unload trailers, verify Bill of Lading (BOL) and packing slips, and scan products into Vista Trac.

  • Stock ingredients and materials on designated racks.

  • Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), and FDA/USDA regulations.

  • Report any food safety issues, equipment failures, or facility concerns to the supervisor immediately.

  • Assume duties of other Processing Technicians or the Receiving Manager as needed during absences.

  • Perform other duties as assigned to support production and operational goals.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED preferred.

  • 1–2 years of experience in a manufacturing or food processing environment is a plus.

  • Ability to read and follow batch recipes and standard operating procedures.

  • Familiarity with inventory systems such as Vista Trac is preferred.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to food safety.

  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.

  • Good communication skills and a proactive work ethic.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

  • Must be able to stand for 8–10 hours per shift.

  • Must lift 50+ lbs. repeatedly throughout the shift.

  • Repetitive motion and physical activity are required.

  • Work is performed in a refrigerated/cold environment.

  • PPE must be worn at all times in production areas.

  • Noise levels may be moderate to high depending on machinery.

Benefits Offered

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid time off and holidays

  • Flexible schedule

  • Employee assistance program (EAP)

Compliance and Safety

This position must comply with all company policies, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), OSHA, USDA, and FDA regulations. Employees are expected to maintain a safe work environment and report any safety or food safety concerns immediately.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Western Smokehouse Partners is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. We are committed to compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local labor laws.

title: New Job Opening: Google Data & AI Engineer in Sydney, NSW
description:
Job Description

Google Data & AI Engineer (GCP)



SELECT engineer


FROM `talent.gcp`


WHERE builds_pipelines = TRUE


AND builds_platform = TRUE


AND certified = 'Professional'


-- Expected rows: 1. Is it you?



Most data engineers stop at the pipeline. This role wants someone who also builds the platform underneath it.



The opportunity


This is a permanent role with a major Australian enterprise. You'll build and run their Google Cloud data platform end to end, from ingestion to the infrastructure it sits on.



What you'll be doing



  • Building batch and streaming pipelines with Dataflow, Composer and Pub/Sub, landing in BigQuery

  • Shaping BigQuery models so queries run fast and costs stay sensible

  • Building the data foundations that machine learning and AI models are trained and run on

  • Writing the Terraform, networking and security that keep the platform sound

  • Owning pipelines in production: monitoring, fixing, and automating releases through CI/CD

  • Working alongside data scientists, analysts and engineers to deliver what they need

  • Keeping an eye on new GCP services worth bringing in



What you'll bring



  • Strong hands-on GCP data engineering, streaming included

  • Advanced Terraform and enterprise-grade GCP cloud engineering

  • Confidence with VPCs, subnets, load balancing, firewalls and DNS

  • Python or Bash, plus Git, Docker and Kubernetes

  • DataOps habits: automated testing and data quality built in from the start

  • A Professional-level Google Cloud certification



The package



  • $140K to $180K base, plus super and bonus

  • Hybrid, with three days a week on site

  • Australian work rights required; background checks apply



If you've built both the pipelines and the platform, I'd love to hear from you.

title: Mental Health Professional- Community and School Based (4325)
description:
About Us

National Counseling Group has been the most trusted provider for Home-Based and Community services in Virginia since 1993. Through the years, our dedication to excellence, results and innovation has resulted in becoming the leading provider for mental, behavioral, and substance use services.

Our dedication to the individuals we serve and the communities in which they live is the foundation for everything we do. With passionate and knowledge staff, we are able to make an impact with individuals who need it most.

About the Role

Are you a compassionate and dedicated mental health professional looking to make a meaningful impact? National Counseling Group (NCG), an ncgCARE partner, is seeking a Mental Health Professional to join our team. At National Counseling Group, our mission is to deliver compassionate, evidence-based care across multiple service types. In this role, you will lead critical aspects of client care, including crisis intervention, case management, skill-building, and therapeutic interventions. By developing and implementing individualized treatment plans, you will help clients build resilience, reach their goals, and thrive. Join our team and help transform lives by supporting families and children in need! The Mental Health Professional plays a vital role in our mission to deliver coordinated, individualized care to our communities.


As a Mental Health Professional, you will:

  • Case Management & Documentation: Maintain accurate and timely case records per licensing and Medicaid standards, ensuring continuity and quality of care.
  • Crisis Intervention: Provide direct support during crisis situations, helping clients to navigate and stabilize through effective case management.
  • Service Planning & Coordination: Coordinate and develop Individualized Service Plans with input from team members and stakeholders to align treatment goals.
  • Trauma-Informed Counseling: Deliver person-centered, trauma-informed, and psycho-educational interventions designed to support treatment objectives.
  • Individual & Family Therapy: Facilitate individual, family, and group counseling sessions, utilizing approved credentialing and skill set.

title: HOURLY TECHNICIAN
description:
Toyota of Renton, a dealership in the O'Brien Auto Group, is looking for Hourly Technicians who are seeking the opportunity to advance in factory training while working in a clean, and fast-paced shop along the way.

Job Summary:
The Technician will be directly responsible for the repair and diagnosis of incoming vehicles in a professional and timely manner.

Responsibilities to Include:

  • Perform all work as designated on repair orders.
  • Inform service advisor if additional work is needed.
  • Assist in training and supervising of apprentices/T-10 students (when applicable).
  • Attend all training sessions and meetings.
  • Maintain a neat and orderly work area.
  • Obey all company, OSHA, WISHA, environmental and other rules, regulations, and automotive laws.
  • Diagnose customer vehicles and repair as needed.
  • Properly describe cause and cure on every finished repair order.
  • Responsible for quality of workmanship. Test drive before and after completion of repairs as needed.
  • Understand that diagnosis time is included in most operation times.
  • Inform dispatch or service advisor of any delays in which the promised time cannot be met.
  • Escalate any did not duplicate to the shop lead, dispatch, diagnostic specialist or service manager.
  • Return all spent parts in bin to the parts department upon completion.

Areas of Specialization:

  • Air Conditioning System: Install air conditioners, know how to service and repair all components of the refrigeration system.
  • Manual Transmission and Clutch System: Knows how to diagnose and repair all components of the clutch and manual transmission system.
  • Automatic Transmission/Transaxle System: Has thorough knowledge of all parts of the automatic transmission system and theory on which it operates, performs special tests that check performance, repairs and replaces linkage, gear trains, hydraulic, electronic, and other parts of the automatic transmission.
  • Brake System/ABS System: Knows how to service and is experienced in all minor and major brake repairs.
  • Accessories Installation: Know how to install all special factory-offered accessories.
  • Electrical Diagnosis and Repair: Has thorough knowledge to use all industry electrical diagnostic equipment. Knows how to diagnose all electrical components and perform needed repairs.
  • Heavy Duty Engine Repairs: Knows how to diagnose and repair all external and internal engine parts including complete overhauls. Has thorough knowledge of the emissions systems.
  • Runability Diagnosis and Repairs: Has completed training in runability systems. Works with specialized equipment to discover cause of engine, fuel system, or electrical/computer problems. Knows how to diagnose or to repair all emission systems. Follows all local and federal emission laws and regulations.
  • Front End/Steering Systems: Knows how to operate front end alignment equipment. Knows how to balance wheels, align front ends (4 ways). Knows how to diagnose and repair front end steering systems as per manufacturers specifications and recommendations.
  • Rear End: Has thorough knowledge of all parts of the rear end/differential system. Has the ability to diagnose problems and repair as needed.
  • General Repairs and Services: Takes care of minor body adjustments, tune ups, other services, LOFs radiator service, water leaks, squeaks, and rattles.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management.
  • Regular attendance is essential.
  • Work in cooperative, positive & professional manner with all personnel in the company.
  • Treat members of the public and customers in a courteous and non-discriminatory manner. Maintain professional demeanor while at work.
  • Must conform to company policy regarding non-discrimination and harassment.


Equipment/Machines/Tools Typically Used: Hydraulic or electric hoists, hydraulic jacks, engine hoists, jack stands, brake lathes, mechanical or hydraulic presses, drill press, tire servicing equipment, grinders, electric or gas welding equipment, diagnostic equipment, hand and air tools, and measuring tools. Hearing protection as required, face shield, clear goggles, welding goggles, respirators, face masks, and appropriate shoes.

Chemicals: Numerous chemicals are used/handled on a frequent basis. Employee will be trained by their supervisor on the safe handling/use of these substances. Employee will follow all safety directives at all times.

Physical Demands: Intermittent standing, walking, sitting, stooping, kneeling, and crouching; lifting 50 lbs or less on frequent basis and carrying 25 lbs or less on frequent basis; frequent pushing, pulling, twisting and turning of trunk, reaching and handling of objects; occasional climbing, balancing, and crawling.

This is not necessarily an exhaustive list of responsibilities, skills, duties, requirements, efforts, or working conditions associated with the job. While this list is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current job, the Dealership reserves the right to revise the functions and duties of the job or
to require that additional or different tasks be performed when circumstances change (i.e., emergencies, changes in personnel, work load, rush jobs, or technological developments).

Candidates for this position must possess a valid Driver’s License and maintain an acceptable driving record in accordance with company policy. Employment offers are contingent upon successful completion of a comprehensive background screening and motor vehicle record review.

Toyota of Renton is an equal opportunity employer and a drug-free workplace.

title: Quality Assurance Assistant 1st Shift
description:
Join the TEAM at Western Smokehouse Partners!

We’re more than just a leader in the better-for-you meat snack industry-we’re a team driven by quality, innovation and a passion for great meat sticks and jerky. With eight facilities across five states, we’re setting the standard in excellence for our co-manufacturing and private label customers. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for highly motivated individuals who want to be part of an industry-leading company that values contribution, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Western Smokehouse Partners is looking for a Quality Assurance Assistant.

The Quality Assurance Assistant supports the QA team in maintaining product excellence and food safety by assisting with audits, quality checks, and documentation. This role contributes to enforcing policies and procedures across production areas to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and company quality objectives, especially within the Ready-To-Eat (RTE) segment.

Essential Duties

  • Assist the FSQA Manager with Pre-Operational (Pre-Op) checks and related procedures.

  • Monitor production activities to verify compliance with quality and food safety standards, including checking ingredients, water activity, pH, rack tags, labels, boxes, caddies, and machine documentation.

  • Contribute to achieving quality assurance goals by supporting data collection, analysis, and strategic planning efforts.

  • Prepare and complete action plans for quality and production improvements.

  • Support implementation of production, productivity, quality, and customer service standards.

  • Identify, investigate, and help resolve quality issues within the production process.

  • Assist in conducting internal audits to verify the effectiveness of food safety and quality systems.

  • Aid in developing quality assurance plans, including hazard analyses and identifying Critical Control Points (CCPs).

  • Help establish critical limits, monitoring procedures, corrective actions, and verification processes.

  • Validate quality processes by measuring production outputs, documenting evidence, and updating QA procedures.

  • Participate in quality documentation preparation and reporting, including tracking failed processes, stability studies, recalls, corrective actions, and re-validations.

  • Maintain oversight of the facility’s pest control program and related equipment.

  • Maintain and store quality and food safety documentation accurately.

  • Verify label information to ensure quality compliance for production runs.

  • Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), and FDA regulations.

Required Qualifications

  • Food safety or Ready-To-Eat (RTE) production experience preferred.

  • Quality Assurance, FSQR, or QC experience preferred.

  • HACCP training preferred; formal training required for internal audits and company training administration.

  • Basic math skills: addition, subtraction, multiplication, division.

  • General computer skills and familiarity with calculators.

  • Ability and willingness to learn computer traceability and inventory systems.

  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Effective communication and teamwork abilities.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

  • Ability to stand, walk, and bend frequently during shifts.

  • Work is performed in a manufacturing environment, including production areas with varying temperature and noise levels.

  • Use of personal protective equipment (PPE) required.

Benefits Offered:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid time off and paid holidays

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Compliance and Safety

This position must comply with all company policies, GMPs, FDA regulations, OSHA standards, and Illinois Department of Labor rules. Employees are expected to report any safety, quality, or compliance concerns to supervisors immediately.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Western Smokehouse Partners is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. We are committed to compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local labor laws.

title: Motion Graphics Designer
description:
Here is a summary of the role:

This experienced candidate will play an essential role in the conception, design, and animation of compelling, on-brand motion graphics campaigns, as well as support for static and print deliverables across multiple channels. This isn’t just a basic After Effects position – we’re looking for someone who lives and breathes motion, who loves learning and sharing new tricks, who gets excited about cool plugins and particle generators, who even likes messing around in C4D, and who loves bringing big ideas to life with craft and creativity. This person will bring exceptional creative thought, design craft, and animation output, developing and delivering projects from brief to final file. They will approach every project with fresh eyes, connect with the team as a fellow creative, and create and inspire work that is distinctive, effective, and truly remarkable.

What you will do:

  • Concept, design, and animate promotional and brand videos, primarily short-form motion graphics (:15 and :30 spots) for broadcast, OLV, social, and digital placements.
  • Develop conceptual storyboards and bring them to life with compelling animation.
  • Design and build static campaign assets, including digital banners, emails, landing pages, print, and presentations as needed.
  • Create on-strategy designs for campaigns across multiple channels, maintaining brand consistency and elevating creative wherever possible.
  • Balance form and function, with a solid understanding of executing projects through both design and motion phases.
  • Confidently present ideas and work to internal teams and clients.
  • Collaborate with Copywriters, Creative Directors, and fellow designers to craft solutions that clearly meet briefs and exceed expectations.
  • Stay current on design, motion, and illustration trends, especially within social and digital video.
  • Build print-ready mechanicals for traditional deliverables as needed.
  • Manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.




What you should have:

  • portfolio of work required
  • 3+ years of design and motion graphics experience, preferably agency-side.
  • Strong conceptual thinking and the ability to ideate from scratch, with illustration skills that enhance your design and motion work.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, After Effects, Cinema 4D, and Premiere.
  • Working knowledge of Photoshop, InDesign, and Audition; understanding of Figma is also plus.
  • Ability to work with light audio editing for projects as needed.
  • Active knowledge, curiosity, and interest in working with AI tools.
  • Strong knowledge of both digital and print design fundamentals.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, dynamic work environment.
  • Excellent time management, organizational, and presentation skills.
  • A humble, hard-working, and patient work ethic, capable of handling critiques while providing individual solutions.
  • Strong and assertive verbal and written communication skills
  • A love for solving problems proactively, resourcefully, and creatively
  • Innate balance of both detail-oriented and big picture thinking
  • Ability to thrive and prioritize in a very fast-paced, dynamic, deadline-driven work environment
  • Strong knowledge and proficiency in Google Suite (Slides, Docs, Sheets, etc.)

title: FSQA Regulatory Compliance Mgr
location: Galesburg IL Main Street - Galesburg, IL 61401
description:
Join the TEAM at Western Smokehouse Partners!

We’re more than just a leader in the better-for-you meat snack industry-we’re a team driven by quality, innovation and a passion for great meat sticks and jerky. With eight facilities across five states, we’re setting the standard in excellence for our co-manufacturing and private label customers. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for highly motivated individuals who want to be part of an industry-leading company that values contribution, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

FSQA Regulatory Compliance Manager will lead, manage, and secure regulatory compliance for WSP's USDA Inspected facilities across our RTE meat and poultry product lines. This critical leadership role will oversee a team of direct-report FSQA Regulatory Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), driving the strategy and execution of all food safety, quality assurance, and compliance initiatives. This role will bridge the gap between plant operations and regulatory bodies, maintaining a robust culture of food safety, with a focus on identifying and mitigating risks across all processes and product lines.

Primary Responsibilities

• Regulatory Oversight: Manage interactions and compliance with high level USDA Food Safety and Inspection Services (FSIS) personnel, including District Office personnel, as well as members of other USDA departments. Support the FSQA teams in managing their interactions and compliance with their on-site USDA FSIS inspectors and personnel, as well as their interactions within the Public Health and Information System (PHIS).

• HACCP and SSOP Management: Oversee, lead the validation of, and manage updates to HACCP plans, Sanitation Standard Operating Procedures (SSOPs), and prerequisite programs.

• Listeria and Pathogen Control: Lead the maintenance of, and maintain the efficacy of, rigorous environmental monitoring programs, targeting Listeria monocytogenes and other pathogens in the RTE post-lethality environments of WSP's facilities.

• Regulatory Monitoring: Track changes to USDA, FDA, and international regulations affecting WSP's product lines, incoming materials and ingredients, and processes.

• Audit Readiness: Lead the management of internal and external audit processes, including SQF (GFSI) standards, and 3rd Party Audits or Inspections. Ensure team preparedness to serve as subject matter experts, in their specific areas of responsibility, during third-party audits or inspections.

Minimum Qualifications

• Education: High School Diploma or GED. Bachelor’s degree in food science, Microbiology, Animal Science, or related technical field preferred.

• Experience: Minimum 7-10 years of FSQA or Regulatory Compliance experience in a USDA meat/poultry RTE processing industry, or closely related field.

• Regulation Expertise: Extensive knowledge of USDA-FSIS regulations including 9 CFR and 21 CFR. Knowledge of FDA Appendix 1.

• Technology Skills: Proficient at using computers, including programs such as Excel and Adobe Acrobat, Outlook, Word, SharePoint, etc.

• Certifications: HACCP certification required; SQF Practitioner or PCQI certification preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

• Meat Stick Experience: Direct experience reviewing supplier and/or ingredient reviews and approvals. Experience with meat sticks, poultry sticks, jerky, or other meat snacks.

• Communication / Team Skills: Experience communicating daily with team members, suppliers, customers via telephone, email, and conference calls. Experience managing and holding to account a Team, to ensure that responsibilities are executed at a high level.

• Related USDA Experience / Background:

  • Experience with managing programs compliant with GFSI code; specifically, SQF.
  • Experience interacting with USDA Policy via AskFSIS.
  • Knowledge of applicable USDA-FSIS Guidance resources.
  • Experience interacting with FSIS Labeling and Program Delivery Staff (LPDS) and navigating their LSAS Portal.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

  • Must be able to stand, walk, bend, and lift up to 50 lbs. for extended periods.
  • Work is performed in a cold, wet, or humid environment depending on the room.
  • Frequent exposure to cleaning chemicals and equipment noise.
  • Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) is required at all times in designated areas.

Benefits Offered:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Compliance and Safety

This position must comply with all company policies, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), OSHA regulations, and Illinois Department of Labor standards. Employees are required to follow all safety protocols and report any unsafe conditions to a supervisor immediately.

Equal Employment Opportunity Western Smokehouse Partners is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. We are committed to compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local labor laws.

If you’re looking for a workplace where you’re valued, supported, and where you’ll be a part of a team that’s shaping the future of meat snacks, we’d love to have you join us!

title: Grants Development Associate
description:
At Children’s Hunger Alliance, we believe every child deserves the chance to reach their full potential and thrive. CHA is leading the charge to end childhood hunger in Ohio, providing healthy meals and nutrition education to children right where they are, every day of the year.

Founded in 1970, CHA plays a unique and vital role in Ohio as the largest comprehensive statewide organization focused solely on children’s food security and nutrition education. We meet kids right where they are — in childcare, at school, after school, over weekends, and during the summer. In 2025, we provided 10.1 million meals to 125,000 kids. With nearly 1,600 partner sites across 74 counties, we provide direct service, capacity-building, and education — all aimed at nourishing children’s futures.

We are seeking a talented and mission-driven person to serve as the Grants Development Associate to support our fundraising efforts and expand our ability to secure philanthropic funding for programs addressing childhood hunger.

Position Summary

The Grants Development Associate will be responsible for researching, developing, writing, and submitting compelling grant proposals and reports that communicate the organization's mission, impact, and funding needs.

The Grants Development Associate will identify and pursue funding opportunities from a diverse range of grant-making organizations, including corporations, private foundations, and family foundations. The successful candidate will be an excellent writer and storyteller who can translate program activities and outcomes into persuasive funding proposals while maintaining strong attention to detail, deadlines, and funder requirements.

This position will work closely with organizational leadership and program staff to gather information, develop funding strategies, prepare proposals, and ensure that grant commitments and reporting requirements are fulfilled.

Key Responsibilities

Grant Research & Prospecting

  • Research and identify corporations, private foundations, family foundations, and other philanthropic organizations whose funding priorities align with the organization's mission and programs.
  • Maintain a pipeline of prospective grant opportunities and track application deadlines, requirements, and funding priorities.
  • Evaluate potential funders and recommend opportunities based on organizational fit, eligibility, geographic focus, and likelihood of success.
  • Monitor changes in funder priorities and identify emerging funding opportunities related to childhood hunger, food insecurity, nutrition, children and families, education, health, and community well-being.

Grant Proposal Development

  • Write and coordinate compelling letters of inquiry, grant proposals, concept papers, applications, and supporting materials.
  • Develop customized proposals that clearly communicate the organization's need, programs, measurable outcomes, community impact, and funding requirements.
  • Work with program and leadership staff to collect relevant statistics, program information, budgets, success stories, and other proposal content.
  • Develop persuasive narratives that demonstrate the connection between childhood hunger and the organization's programs and services.
  • Ensure proposals accurately reflect organizational priorities, program activities, budgets, and anticipated outcomes.
  • Coordinate submission of grant applications and ensure all materials are complete and submitted on time.

Grant Reporting & Stewardship

  • Prepare timely and compelling grant reports, renewal requests, and other funder communications.
  • Track grant deliverables, reporting deadlines, and funding requirements.
  • Work with staff to collect program outcomes, participant stories, financial information, and other data needed for reports.
  • Support positive relationships with funders through clear, accurate, and compelling communications.
  • Maintain organized electronic files and records related to proposals, awards, reports, and funder correspondence.

title: CNC & Manual Machinists ( 1st & 2nd Shifts) (63834)
description:
Machinist – 1st & 2nd Shift- 20% Shift diff for 2nd shift.

Reading Bakery Systems | Robesonia, PA
Full-Time | Non-Exempt | Manufacturing

Reading Bakery Systems seeks a 2nd Shift Machinist to join our Manufacturing team in Robesonia, PA. This position interprets engineering drawings and operates manual and CNC metal-cutting equipment to manufacture high-precision components for industrial bakery systems.

The Machinist works with Engineering and Manufacturing leadership to ensure parts are produced accurately, meet quality standards, and support efficient assembly operations.

What You’ll Do

  • Interpret engineering drawings, assembly drawings, and bills of materials to determine machining and assembly requirements.

  • Set up and operate saws, drill presses, lathes, surface grinders, key seaters, milling machines, CNC machining centers, and CNC lathes.

  • Select proper cutting tools, feeds, speeds, and cutting fluids to maintain required dimensions, tolerances, and surface finishes.

  • Edit or write simple CNC programs using G-code and M-code.

  • Inspect parts during machining using precision measuring tools such as micrometers, calipers, and gauges.

  • Align, fit, deburr, polish, attach, tighten, and adjust machined parts and assemblies.

  • Make mechanical adjustments to maintain proper clearances, operating parameters, and accuracy.

  • Support assembly of industrial bakery machinery, including fitting components, attaching parts, basic welding tasks, and verifying proper part movement.

  • Organize component parts and subassemblies to support production flow.

  • Complete required production and quality control records.

  • Clean equipment and maintain a safe, organized work area.

  • Follow company safety policies, occupational health programs, and operating procedures.

  • Provide feedback to coworkers, supervisors, and management to support efficient manufacturing operations.

  • When needed, assist with Machinist Coordinator duties and provide technical guidance to other machinists.

Working Conditions

This role is performed in a manufacturing environment and requires standing, walking, reaching, handling tools and materials, and performing close visual work. The employee may occasionally stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, or lift up to 50 pounds.

The work environment may include exposure to moving mechanical parts, fumes or airborne particles, vibration, wet or humid conditions, and high noise levels requiring hearing protection. Appropriate personal protective equipment is required.

Why Join Reading Bakery Systems?

At Reading Bakery Systems, our team designs and manufactures innovative industrial bakery equipment used by customers around the world. You’ll be part of a hands-on manufacturing environment where precision, craftsmanship, teamwork, safety, and quality matter every day.

title: Flexo Printing Press Operator
description:
Whitlam Group is seeking an experienced Flexographic Printing Press Operator to join our manufacturing team. In this hands-on role, you’ll set up, operate and maintain flexographic printing presses to produce high-quality pressure-sensitive and specialty labels that meet the highest standards for quality, accuracy and customer satisfaction.

As a key member of our production team, you’ll work closely with Press Assistants and fellow operators to maximize efficiency, minimize waste and ensure every job is completed safely, accurately and on schedule. If you have strong mechanical aptitude, take pride in producing exceptional work and enjoy working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, we’d love to hear from you.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Set up and operate flexographic printing presses according to production schedules and customer specifications.
  • Review job tickets, artwork and production requirements to ensure accurate job setup.
  • Verify proper registration and impression of printing plates.
  • Install and prepare press components, tooling and related equipment for production.
  • Monitor print quality, color consistency and registration throughout production runs, making adjustments as needed.
  • Inspect finished products to ensure they meet customer specifications and company quality standards.
  • Troubleshoot print quality issues, equipment concerns and material inconsistencies, escalating maintenance issues when appropriate.
  • Perform routine cleaning, preventive maintenance and press changeovers to maximize equipment performance.
  • Minimize waste and downtime through efficient press operation and continuous process improvement.
  • Accurately document production data, quality checks and material usage.
  • Train and mentor Press Assistants and Trainees to support team development.
  • Follow all company safety policies, quality standards and operating procedures.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience operating flexographic printing presses.
  • Experience with UV, water-based and/or solvent-based ink systems.
  • Strong understanding of flexographic printing processes, color management and print quality.
  • Knowledge of anilox rolls, plate mounting, registration and impression adjustments.
  • Ability to read and interpret job tickets, specifications and technical documentation.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude with excellent troubleshooting skills.
  • Basic math and measurement skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to producing quality work.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Strong communication, teamwork and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to stand for extended periods and lift materials weighing up to 50 pounds.

ABOUT WHITLAM GROUP

Whitlam Group is a leading manufacturer of pressure-sensitive labels and specialty packaging solutions, serving customers across a wide range of industries. We are committed to quality, innovation and continuous improvement, investing in our people, technology and processes to deliver exceptional products, outstanding service and long-term value to our customers.

WHY JOIN WHITLAM GROUP

At Whitlam Group, our employees are the driving force behind our success. We foster a safe, collaborative and team-oriented work environment where quality, innovation and continuous improvement are valued every day. You’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills, work alongside experienced professionals and build a rewarding career with an industry leader.

WE OFFER

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance.
  • 401(k) retirement plan.
  • Paid time off and paid holidays.
  • Career development and advancement opportunities.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
  • Tuition reimbursement.

If you’re an experienced Flexographic Printing Press Operator who takes pride in producing high-quality work and is looking to grow your career with an industry leader, we’d love to hear from you.

Schedule: First shift, Monday – Friday 6:30am – 3:00pm.

Work Environment: Year-round climate-controlled manufacturing facility.

description:

description:

As we continue to grow and serve more residents across the Midwest, we are looking for compassionate, driven individuals to join our team. If you’re looking for a fresh start, a new opportunity, or a chance to build a meaningful career in healthcare, we invite you to apply today!

POSITION PURPOSE:

The CNA is responsible for providing residents with the highest quality of direct routine care in all activities of daily living, under the supervision of the LPN or RN and in accordance with the Nursing Assistant Program standards, the Resident’s Bill of Rights and the facility Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement (QAPI) program. According to the Plan of Care for the resident, CNAs apply skills in basic nursing, personal care and basic restorative services while understanding the mental health and social service needs of the resident and being mindful of the needs in cognitively impaired residents. The CNA is part of the interdisciplinary care team that is dedicated to promoting independence, autonomous decision-making and facilitating residents to achieve and maintain the highest practicable physical mental and psychosocial well-being.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF POSITION:

QUALITY OF CARE

  • Provides ongoing resident care upholding and promoting the resident’s right to be free from abuse, mistreatment, neglect, or misappropriation of resident property, immediately reporting any suspicions, reports or witnessed events to appropriate facility staff.
  • Forms quality relationships, communicating and interacting competently on a one-to-one basis while integrating the resident-centered Plan of Care
  • Demonstrates sensitivity to physical, mental, and psychosocial needs as well as maintaining dignity, while skillfully performing directed nursing, personal cares and restorative services
  • Supports and promotes residents’ rights and attainment of as much functional independence as possible.
  • Maximizes quality of living through continual monitoring and reporting of resident care, ensuring all outcomes are thoroughly and accurately documented.
  • Provides the highest quality care to all residents, without regard to race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, age or differences in culture.
  • Maintains awareness of facility QAPI goals and abides by and promotes the QAPI program.
  • Practices and promotes a strong culture of customer service, ensuring a resident-centered experience.

BASIC NURSING, PERSONAL CARES AND BASIC RESTORATIVE SERVICES

  • Facilitates Plan of Care through completion of nursing responsibilities, clearly communicating resident needs to primary caregivers and reporting changes and responses to interventions to the LPN or RN
  • Completes basic nursing cares as directed such as taking and recording vital signs; measuring and recording height and weight; recognizing abnormal changes in body functioning and reporting to the LPN or RN; and caring for resident who are actively dying.
  • Completes personal care as directed such as bathing; grooming; mouth care; dressing; toileting; eating and hydration; proper feeding techniques; skin care; and transfers, positioning and turning.
  • Facilitates adequate nutritional intake for resident through assisting to and from the dining area; feeding or assisting to feed; monitoring and recording intake and output; passing water and offering fluids; passing and collecting trays; serving supplemental nourishment as directed by nurse; maintaining awareness of dietary restrictions; and following safety guidelines including wearing gloves when handling food or hydration.
  • Completes basic restorative services as directed such as training residents in self-care and according to the resident’s abilities; use of assistive devices in transferring, ambulation, eating, and dressing; maintenance of range of motion; proper turning and positioning in bed and chair bowel and bladder training; and care and use of prosthetic and orthotic devices.
  • Assist nurses with special procedures as directed, including implementing and completing critical care sheets, participating in care conferences, etc.
  • Provides and ensures nursing care activities are practiced in accordance with Nursing Assistant Program standards while protecting residents’ dignity, privacy, and autonomous decision-making whenever possible.
  • Facilitates assistance in areas such as getting to and participating in activities as well as assistance in resolving any grievances or disputes.
  • Articulates meaningful discussion with residents based on their unique backgrounds, likes and dislikes.
  • Maintains care and security of residents’ personal possessions.
  • Interact with resident’s family or support network, visitors and members of the interdisciplinary care team in a courteous and cooperative manner.
  • Recognizes limits of knowledge, skill and experience; facilitates situations beyond the CNAs competency.

COMPLIANCE – SAFETY, DOCUMENTATION, HIPAA

  • Ensures all call lights are promptly and courteously answered.
  • Uses proper body mechanics at all times and reminds other nursing staff or facilitates correction.
  • Constantly adheres to safety policies and procedures in lifting, positioning and equipment use, including use of transfer belts, Hoyer or mechanical lifts.
  • Strictly follows Standard Precaution infection control procedures and OSHA guidelines regarding bloodborne pathogens to provide safe nursing care to include proper handwashing; maintaining disinfection/cleaning schedules; wearing PPE such as gloves, face shield, fluid resistant gowns, etc.
  • Maintains a safe, clean environment in resident rooms and facility following infection control procedures to bag infectious linens and equipment or proper disposal of them; proper handwashing, disinfection/cleaning schedules.
  • Avoids the need for restraints in accordance with DHS nursing home standards.
  • Ensures all cares are documented and that resident records are complete through systematic collection, reporting and documentation of data that is secure from unauthorized access and follows state and federal regulations, including HIPAA to ensure privacy and maintain confidentiality.
  • Promptly reports and documents incidents and errors involving residents, staff, visitors or self.
  • Prioritizes work assignments consistent with number and level of staff available and resident care acuity.
  • Reviews, departing staff report at start of shift, ensures duties and delegated tasks are complete at end of shift and reports off to nurse when leaving.
